headline: Is Corpay’s Agent Card Deepening Its AI Payments Moat Or Complicating Governance Controls For CPAY?
summary: On 28 July 2026, Corpay announced Agent Card, a new capability that lets AI agents securely create and use virtual cards across procurement, travel, advertising, and other automated workflows while enforcing existing payment controls. The launch highlights Corpay’s push to mesh AI-driven automation with granular governance tools, positioning its virtual card infrastructure for a wider range of machine-to-machine business payments. headline: Is Corpay (CPAY) Fully Valued As Its New AI Agent Card Enters Payments?
summary: Why Corpay’s new AI Agent Card matters for the stock Corpay (CPAY) has introduced Agent Card, a virtual card capability built for AI driven commerce workflows, giving AI agents controlled authority to initiate and complete payments on behalf of business customers. This move extends Corpay’s earlier AI Virtual Assistant for finance teams into actual transaction execution.
